verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents a publishable, customizable Trust Center and continuous monitoring integrations (AWS, GitHub, Google Workspace) plus Fieldwork AI agents that automatically collect and validate evidence, which implies some live control-status updating, but there is no explicit documentation that the Trust Center itself auto-refreshes subprocessor lists or tracks document renewals. missing for 10: explicit mention of automatic subprocessor list updates, automated document/policy renewal tracking, and confirmation that Trust Center control status is pulled live from monitoring/evidence rather than manually maintained.
